title: Java adaptive compiler routing
summary: Reviewed Java candidate spaces that force the lightweight Janino path and the modern ECJ path, include an external dependency JAR, and are checked both without a database and through a bounded full Generator-to-Results run.

source.revision_resolution: Moves with the Framework checkout and is identified by the engine revision.

lifecycle.start: none — each candidate is compiled and run by the Java Executor
lifecycle.stop: none — candidate JVM/compiler work is bounded by the Executor

determinism.reset: Each generated source is compiled in a fresh probe directory; the full-chain gate uses an isolated CI database and run id.
determinism.seed: No random source is used; both spaces enumerate exactly 48 candidates.

oracle.description: Each assembled source has an expected compiler route and deterministic output; ECJ-only language features are also required to fail under forced Janino and succeed under ECJ/adaptive routing.
oracle.independence: Expected routing and output are asserted by the Python test harness outside AdaptiveJavaCompiler; negative controls force the wrong backend rather than asking the router to judge itself.

known_pass: all 48 janino_max sources compile and run under forced Janino
all 48 ecj_modern sources compile and run under forced ECJ and adaptive routing
known_fail: every ecj_modern source is rejected by forced Janino
a missing external rules-api dependency makes the compile probe fail

intentional_defects.description: record/lambda/method-reference/switch-expression combinations exceed the Janino language subset.
intentional_defects.detected_by: forced-Janino negative control plus adaptive-route assertion

cleanup: CI uses an isolated database/run id and an ephemeral runner; local run directories are removed with bundle cleanup.
caveats: The full-chain gate uses trusted-local only because all Java fragments are reviewed and checked in. It is not evidence for untrusted generated Java sandboxing.
The bounded database smoke runs janino_max; the DB-free compiler suite exhaustively checks both 48-case spaces and both backends.
